thread:
julia: Quick pulse 1: need a compact set of micro-heroes for the tri-mode pages (hosted / dedicated / private) plus exact CTA destinations for webinar traffic and trial flows. Keep social headlines punchy (<=9 words).

hamid: I'll throw three distinct tonal directions per mode: builder, economics, trust. We should map webinar CTAs to demo with an optional pricing opt-in.

sophia: For ops: please include exact hrefs + hidden fields so we can wire forms without back-and-forth. Also legal needs the privacy one-liner for Private page.

ben: Dropping drafts for each mode (short headlines + 1-line landing subcopy + CTA target):

Hosted headlines:
- "Ship LLM features with a hosted API"
- "Fast responses, simple SDKs"
- "Lower inference costs as you scale"
Hosted landing sub: "Managed API with streaming, client SDKs, and transparent pricing."
Hosted CTA: /signup?utm=mini_launch_hosted (hidden: campaign=mini_launch, source=social_card)

Dedicated headlines:
- "Reserved GPUs for production traffic"
- "Predictable throughput, SLA-backed"
- "Capacity tuned for steady load"
Dedicated landing sub: "Dedicated GPU pools, autoscaling, and SLA support."
Dedicated CTA: /sales/enterprise?utm=mini_launch_dedicated (hidden: campaign=mini_launch, source=social_card)

Private headlines:
- "Run inference inside your network"
- "On-prem & VPC deployments, enterprise-ready"
- "Full control: audit logs & keys"
Private landing sub: "Customer-managed networking, audit trails, and KMS/HSM integrations."
Private CTA: /sales/private?utm=mini_launch_private (hidden: campaign=mini_launch, source=social_card)

hamid: Webinar CTA language options: "See a live demo & cost snapshot" (for social promos) vs "See performance in action" (on-site demo button). Webinar landing -> /demo?utm=webinar_card (hidden: campaign=mini_launch, tag=webinar_demo)

sophia: Ops notes: add hidden fields experiment=mini_launch_2026 and variant=performance|cost. CRM mapping: webinar_demo -> assign to solutions.eng, trial_signup -> auto-activate trial, enterprise_lead -> AE_queue.

ben: A/B plan: two creative buckets. Variant P (performance-first) highlights latency & stability. Variant C (cost-first) highlights per-token economics. Social split 50/50, landing swaps hero + subcopy. Run length: 14 days. Metrics: social CTR, demo signups, cost estimate requests.

julia: Legal approved microcopy for Private page: "Inputs remain within your infrastructure; Redwood does not store request content." (ref S-2038). Put this under the Private CTA as a small note.

hamid: Example short social posts to pair with cards:
- Performance: "Launch LLM features faster. Join our demo to see benchmarks. #llm"
- Cost: "Lower inference costs as you grow. See a short demo & comparison. #aicosts"

sophia: Make sure webinar CTA routes pre-fill the form with source=social_card and tag=webinar_demo so SDRs see intent. Also add checkbox on demo page: "Request cost estimate" which sets lead_type=pricing_request.

ben: I'll push both hero sets to staging along with UTM examples. Also adding tiny microcopy under CTAs: Hosted -> "Try hosted API (free trial)"; Dedicated -> "Request capacity"; Private -> "Contact sales (security packet available)".

launch-bot: Playbook entry created: https://drive.redwood/playbooks/mini-launch-2026 (edited by ben). Experiment scheduled: id mini-launch-2026, start Fri 09:00 UTC, duration 14 days. Notifications will post to #marketing.

julia: Timeline: Ben -> push to staging by Wed EOD; Sophia -> wire hidden fields + CRM mapping; Hamid -> prepare webinar micro-benchmark slide (single chart + 1-line cost delta); we'll QA Thu and launch Fri. Check-in Monday for early metrics. :rocket:
